primitives.name: Shelf-Filling Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: We're filling our shelves to offer you books from the starchefs and cookbook authors we feature as well as others.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S(t)': 'shelf state at time t (dimensionless)', 'B(t)': 'book inventory at time t (books)'}
primitives.assumptions: Shelf capacity is bounded; book inflow is stochastic but continuous.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S(t) → ∞, system enters overload regime.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Belief propagation over book availability; GSE: State transition from empty to full shelf.
layer2.telemetry: Inventory count B(t) and shelf occupancy S(t)

primitives.name: Amazonian Inventory Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Best of all is that because of our association with Amazon Books we can get any book you want, at any time of day or night...24 hours a day.
primitives.assumptions: Kernel K(t) is deterministic within T; no delay in fulfillment.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Stochastic inference on book availability; GSE: Continuous state update via kernel.
layer2.telemetry: Delivery rate K(t) and time-to-delivery T

primitives.name: Giftwrap Delivery Option
primitives.verbatim_quote: They can even be giftwrapped and delivered with a note for an epicurean friend!
primitives.assumptions: G ∈ {0,1}; D is a binary state variable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When G = 1 and D ≠ 1, delivery fails.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Conditional probability of giftwrap success; GSE: State change in delivery mode.
layer2.telemetry: Boolean G and delivery mode D
